# .github/workflows/enrich-stragglers.yml
# Authoritative enrichment for name-only wrestlers (pulls sumo-api profile, writes to Master Rikishi).
# DRY_RUN defaults to "1" (preview). Flip to "0" to write.
name: enrich-stragglers
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: 'Dry run? 1 = preview only, 0 = write'
        required: true
        default: '1'
      stragglers:
        description: 'Comma-separated shikona to enrich'
        required: false
        default: 'Shiden,Hidenoumi'
jobs:
  enrich-stragglers:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Enrich stragglers
        env:
          NOTION_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NOTION_TOKEN }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ github.event.inputs.dry_run }}
          STRAGGLERS: ${{ github.event.inputs.stragglers }}
        run: node enrich-stragglers.mjs
